name: Toluca
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local/state property or cadastral services were identified, but no point-specific public parcel polygon was verified. No full geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Toluca’s official municipal transparency/process records identify the municipal Catastro unit and cadastral register, parcel boundary/cadastral-plan certification, and geographic cadastral information systems. The municipality’s current official site links SIGTOL, a public interactive geographic-information platform, but does not identify a parcel-cadastre layer.
technicalBlocker: The public viewer linked by SIGTOL refused a normal anonymous connection; no parcel layer/service could be verified. The official landing page’s thematic-map description alone does not establish public parcel geometry.
remainingUncertainty: Whether SIGTOL has a parcel/cadastral layer or only thematic planning layers, and whether the exact point lies in a publicly viewable cadastral layer.
nextStep: Retry only if the official SIGTOL viewer is available; inspect its published layer metadata and query only a bounded ID-plus-geometry response if a cadastral layer exists.
